content: SQLAlchemy 2.0 (latest 2.0.54) async engine + GeoAlchemy2 (latest 0.20.0) + PostGIS is the standard combo for FastAPI apps needing spatial columns/queries (asyncpg or psycopg3 driver); GeoAlchemy2 provides Geometry column types and wraps PostGIS functions (ST_DWithin, ST_ClusterDBSCAN, etc.) as SQLAlchemy expressions.
